Usage: Wrm <command> [options]

Commands
  init           Creates a starting project
  build          Build a worm project
  run            Run the API or MCP service from the project's .wrm script
  deploy         Deploy the project (make-devcert + publish-<target>.ps1)
  test           Test a component in a worm project
  list           Show components of the project
  database       Show database information
  help           Show some help on a specific topic

Options
 -h  <command>   Help on command
 -c  <filepath>  Path to config file
 -d  <api-path>  Path to write API to
 -k              Include ASCII Header 
 -v              Verbose logging (info, warnings, debug)

result.stdout:
Usage: WRM RUN [API|MCP] [<script>]

  RUN                       Runs the API service from the default .wrm script
  RUN <script>              Runs the API service from the named .wrm script
  RUN API [<script>]        Explicit: runs the API service
  RUN MCP [<script>]        Runs the MCP service

The script must contain exactly one CREATE API SERVICE (for RUN/RUN API)
or exactly one CREATE MCP SERVICE (for RUN MCP).
